title: Gandhi Smriti - Remembering the Father of the Nation
content:
Gandhi Smriti - Delhi,

Gandhi Smriti is a famous memorial in Delhi dedicated to Mahatma Gandhi. It is the place where he spent the last 144 days of his life before his assassination in 1948. Today, it is a museum that displays his personal belongings, photographs, and teachings. Walking through Gandhi Smriti gives visitors a peaceful and inspiring experience, connecting them with the life and legacy of the Father of the Nation.

Visitor Information:

  • Location: 5, Tees January Marg, New Delhi,
  • Timings: 10:00 AM – 5:00 PM (Closed on Mondays),
  • Entry Fee: Free for all visitors,
  • Photography: Allowed in limited areas,

How to Reach Gandhi Smriti:

  • By Metro: Nearest station is Lok Kalyan Marg (Yellow Line), about 1 km away.
  • By Bus/Auto: Accessible via DTC buses and auto-rickshaws from Connaught Place and central Delhi.
  • By Car: Well-connected by roads; private vehicles and cabs are convenient.

Parking Information: Limited parking is available near the memorial. Public transport is recommended.

Places to Visit Nearby Gandhi Smriti:

  • India Gate,
  • Rashtrapati Bhavan,
  • Lodhi Gardens,
  • National Museum,

Travel Tips: Carry a small notebook or phone to jot down Gandhi’s inspiring quotes displayed in the museum.
excerpt: Gandhi Smriti in Delhi is a peaceful memorial where Mahatma Gandhi spent his last days. With free entry, a central location, and nearby attractions like India Gate and Rashtrapati Bhavan, it is a must-visit for history lovers and anyone seeking inspiration.
